summary: OpenAI announced a partnership with the American Psychological Association to develop resources and safeguards for youth mental health and AI use, including family-facing guidance, practitioner resources, and youth listening sessions.

categories.reason: The partnership touches clinical and mental health workflows via practitioner resources, but this is a policy collaboration rather than a product or underwriting change affecting health/insurance businesses.
categories.quote: Planned work includes resources for clinicians and school psychologists focused on promoting healthy AI usage, recognizing overreliance, and intervening in unhealthy use patterns.

practices.reason: The document describes an internal, lab-driven safety and monitoring effort (expert network, age-prediction model) that is not a transferable evaluation method for other teams.
practices.quote: We work with more than 260 mental health experts to help ChatGPT better recognize signs of distress, respond with care, and guide people toward real-world support.
